title: Probability-weighted $L^p$ quantity
statement: For a finite set $\Omega$, a probability mass function $\pi$ on $\Omega$, a real number $p$, and a real-valued function $f$ on $\Omega$, define $\|f\|_{p,\pi}=\bigl(\mathbb{E}_{x\sim\pi}[|f(x)|^p]\bigr)^{1/p}$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
